balls.text: just one boundary in the last three overs. This is a slot ball but he has hit it straight to deep midwicket. SRK sacrifices himself trying to run that extra run
full and wide, hit straight of long-off, comes back for two
big wide now. Called too
Ali drops a skier. Simar stays wide of his reach again, and draws a massive edge on a length ball. Moeen runs in from long-on but makes a mess of it. Also two runs

finally nails the wide yorker. This is wide of the blue line but Miller has shuffled across. He still reviews it, but this will not be given, I am sure. Miller has moved across before the release of the ball so Simar is fine

too wide. Called too. Miller seems interested in a no-ball. Did it land inside the cut strip? I think it did. But Miller has reviewed it. The ball went past the wicket while still being inside the cut strip. So not a no-ball
misses the yorker, ends up with a wide full toss. Miller doesn't connect, but the outside edge goes fine of short third
short and wide, SRK cue-ends it towards midwicket for one
quick short ball, pulled down between deep square and deep midwicket. Another superb Thakur over
low full toss, 137ks, SRK gets a leading edge to long-off for one
lovely bowling. Wide yorker, 138ks, beats him altogether
digs this in short, 122ks, pulled to deep midwicket for one
gets a juicy full toss, but he has drilled it straight to mid-off in the circle
surprises him with a straight yorker after many wide balls. They do get a couple to long-on, though
what an over from Deshpande. No boundary plus two wickets. Looks like Gill has lost power. Slower short ball and all he manages is a catch to deep midwicket
slower bouncer, wide outside off, Miller reaches it but gets just the single
wide bouncer, pulled hard, gets a single to deep midwicket
short of a length, on the wide line, just the single

the wide lines have kept them quiet, and now brings them the first wicket. Slower ball, far away from his reach, Sudharsan nearly sweeps himself off his feet trying to hit this, but can only go as far as extra cover. Joint-highest opening partnership in IPL
short, outside off, chest high, pulled down to long-on
tantalisingly close to getting out for 97 again. Gets inside the line of a length ball and almost sweeps it. Long leg is interested but it narrowly clears it. Two hundreds by two openers
wide low full toss, drilled to deep cover for a single
low wide full toss, played to deep point for one
short of a length, wide, punched down to long-off for a single

the 100th IPL hundred. Simar bowls a juicy full toss, and he has guided it through square leg for four. A slightly angry celebration. He usually just takes a bow. Definitely an angry celebration. I lip-read what he said but can't put it here
perfect slower yorker, 128ks, outside off, and beats his bat too
sensational over. No boundary. Nails the leg-side yorker. They get a leg-bye off the toe
wide full toss, Sudharsan tries the hit it over square leg after moving across, but gets just the single to that man
a full toss on the blue wide line, and Gill can get just a single to deep point
follows him with a low full toss as Gill backs away, Gill takes mid-off on, and gets an overthrow too
gets away with it. The length is fine, just a little fuller than a yorker, but it is headed down leg. He is lucky Gill has not got any bat on this but has been hit on the pad
wide full toss, driven straight to deep cover for one
wide yorker, spot on, and they still get two as he has managed to get this wide of long-off
shovelled away to the right of deep midwicket for four. CSK would have expected better from Moeen there, but this has been hit hard. Into the 90s goes Gill too
slower short ball, wide outside off, pulled down to long-on for a single
now the mis-hit falls short. Deshpande has done well by staying wide and away from his reach, Gill skies it down the ground, but it doesn't carry to the advancing long-off
wide yorker but too wide. Called too
nails the yorker, just the single into the leg side
goes for a wide yorker, just the single off the low full toss
gets the yorker right, dug out into the leg side for a single
that is a parallel six. Mitchell misses the yorker, and Gill crashes this half-volley for a low six over extra cover. Carnage
nails the yorker, dug out back to him

back to back. He is waiting for the slower ball here, delays the shot and goes straight towards long-off where Deshpande misses the chance and parries him over for six. He is not on the edge of the boundary, and as a result he has to take this overhead and drops him
manufactures this. Mitchell has kept Gill quiet by bowling it wide outside off, but this time Gill has shuffled across and pulled him over long leg
sees him coming and sneaks in a slower wide yorker at 115ks
into the 90s. Lovely slog sweep. Santner finishes an ordinary over. Right in his wheelhouse, and Sudharsan is down on a knee to send it ways back over deep midwicket
gets some width, cuts it in the air, clears the infield, gets a couple
that's poor. Fires in a 97ks full toss down the leg side. Sudharsan helps it along fine of short fine leg
really slow, wide, on a length, driven to deep cover for one. GT's highest partnership for any wicket
quicker, slightly fuller, flatter, cut away, but straight to backward point
lovely shot. Not a bad ball. On a good length, not too wide, but he has drilled it between long-off and deep extra
short of a length and wide, dragged to deep midwicket for one
Gill advances down the wicket to turn this yorker into a low full toss, and drives it wide of long-on. Deshpande saves two with a dive to his left
short of a length, pulled down to deep midwicket for one
super slow ball, at 95ks, ends up being a full bunger, Sudharsan has enough time to recover and drill it wide of long-on
gives him width and full length with mid-off up, and Sadharsan accepts it with glee, going over the man
short of a length, pulled down to long-on
upper-cut for a six. Simarjeet is trying to go short, and the boundaries behind the wicket are not big enough here. Sudharsan slashes at it, and it flies over deep third. That's 23 off the over

slower bouncer, gets good height, but is down the leg side with fine leg up. Sudharsan needs to just get some bat on it, and even though the bottom hand comes off when connecting, it flies for a six over fine leg
another slower-ball yorker, 124ks, outside off, dug out for a single now
slower ball, yorker outside off, dug out for a dot
clubbed down the ground. Misses the stumps at the bowler's end narrowly, and it bisects long-on and long-off. He is on a rampage
gets to fifty with a top-edged pull. Short of a length, down the leg side, and he just has to help it along really. This ball is asking to be hit
cut away in front of deep point for a couple
on-pace, short of a length, top of off, and Sudharsan has punched this down the ground and straight of mid-off for four. Another lovely shot
again slower short ball, 110ks, wide outside off, clubbed down to long-on for one
looks to ramp this from outside off, gets bat on it, but has no pace to work with. Just the single to short fine
slower short ball, 106ks, pulled down to long-on for one

lovely straight drive on the up, misses the wicket at non-striker's end narrowly, and goes all the way for four. He has managed to impart enough power even though Mitchell is giving them no pace to work with
fired into the pads, swept to deep square leg for one
punched down to long-on for one
Sudharsan is opening up. A second six off Jadeja. Makes room, gets down on a knee, and slog-sweeps him for a six to get to his fifty off 32 balls. He has made ground in this over
sweeps this length ball away, fine of deep square for a couple
finally Sudharsan gets the pull going. And he has placed it through straight deep midwicket for four
sees Gill coming, shortens the length, just the single to long-off
Mitchell gets out of the over with six singles. Short of a length, wide, away from his reach, drilled down to long-on for one
slower ball again, the fullest and the widest ball of the over. Called too
slower ball, short of a length, again no timing on the pull. Just the single to long-on
short of a length, 121ks, no room, pulled to deep midwicket
short of a length, pulled down to long-on for another single
short of a length, wicket to wicket, 126ks, punched down to long-on for a single
slower ball first up, 119ks, on a length, no room, punched into the off side for one
quick, short of a length, punched down to long-on for one

soft hands, worked into the vast spaces into the leg side, comes back for two, but then they also get four overthrows. It is Santner's throw, which Ravindra seems to have covered, but he lets it through
on a length, slow in the air, punched down towards long-off
goes down on his back knee to pull-sweep this length ball to deep square
on a length, on the pads, worked to leg for one
boundary first ball. Jadeja has just dragged it down slightly, and Gill plays his trademark short-arm jab, which he has timed so well that it beats long-on and deep midwicket
short of a length, around off, pushed wide of cover for one
lovely shot. This is good length at 144ks. No way it is driving length, but Gill stands tall, plays it on the up, and lofts him over mid-on. Incredible shot
stays short of a length, 146ks, now he has warmed up. Tucked to leg for a single
short of a length, 141ks, punched away off the hip for a couple
wide length ball, 138ks, seems down on pace today. Driven to the right of deep point, and they sneak in the second
short of a length, wide, 137ks, cut away, but can't beat backward point
short of a length, outside off, he has a backward point to sweep it. Excellent comeback over from Thakur after conceding a six and a four in the first
thick edge to backward point, and they steal a single on the arm of Deshpande
fullish, middle and leg, punched down to mid-on. A bit of a check drive
on a length, no room, flicked to deep square leg for one
looks to run this fine but short third is fine too. Successive dots now
short of a length, gets a little big on him, pulled uppishly to midwicket. Bounces just short
short of a length, tucked away off the hip for one
flicked away off the hip for a couple to deep midwicket
slower ball, outside off, left alone. Not called a wide, and they decide against reviewing it. I though it was a wide, but then again they don't want to risk a review this early on a wide
on a length, on the pads, but there is a sweeper on the leg side to keep them down to one
short of a length, outside off, he has the field for this. Just the single to deep point
poor bowling. Dug in short, but only hip high and also down leg. Sudharsan helps it along for a flat six over long leg
Gill is in great touch. A hit-me ball on the pads, but it is the way he has put it way. Languidly, he flicks it away, just square of the diving midwicket for four
slower ball, 116ks, but a leg-stump half-volley, which Sudharsan has flicked for just a single
on a length, slight nip in, flicked to midwicket
Sudharsan gets going with a sumptuous extra-cover drive. Gets on a knee, gets under this length ball, and drives it over extra cover. Pure timing
digs this in, Sudharsan arches back and tries to ramp it, but completely misses it
on a length, driven on the up, but can't get it past short straight cover

thick edge as Gill drives on the up and away from the body. There is no backward point, and this goes four to deep backward point. Sweeper-cover Jadeja puts in a big dive but can't prevent the boundary
driven on the up, straight to mid-off, who is on the edge of the circle. They sneak in the single
short of a length now, no room, punched to cover
inside edge on this as Sudharsan looks to drive wide of mid-off. Ends up playing to leg. Deshpande stays on a good length
this one nips in off the surface. Gill gets an inside edge into his thigh pad. It might have missed the protection as Gill is on some pain
outswinger, on a length, just outside off, defended off the front foot
wide down the leg side
arm ball, swinging in, punched down to mid-off for one
superb shot. Down the wicket, close to the pitch of the ball, and lofts it beautifully over mid-on. Languid
back to arm ball. This one swings in, and is defended back
lovely square-drive. Santner overpitches a touch. Only a touch, but enough for Gill to drive this in front of backward point. Just the open face on that places the ball
arm ball, swinging away from the left-hand bat, flicked into the leg side for a single
into the surface, Sudharsan goes down on a knee and pulls this to deep square for two
he's expecting the wrong'un again and he goes back to finally connect, and whip it behind square to end the night with a four
the googly turns in, Dhoni can't connect as it goes off the pads
takes a step down and whips this down to long-on for one. Oh, but they decide not to run

a loud and never-ending lbw appeal from Rashid Khan for lbw! Not given, GT review it. It was the wrong'un that came in sharply, Dhoni was a long way forward and the ball went through to hit him on the back pad in front of the stumps. We're waiting for UltraEdge. No edge. Pitching outside off, impact in line, but bouncing over leg stump. The crowd loves it
make that two in two! Too short, this time he rocks back and dispatches it square of the wicket, again with one hand coming off the bat. Lands in the crowd
oh, Dhoni comes down the ground to take that on the full and flicks that with his powerful and whippy wrists over the cow corner for six!
117.5kmh, and very aptly it's slow and deceiving well outside off, Thakur swings and misses
slow and short of Kieth at 113.4kmh, Dhoni waits and waits before pulling it away to deep square leg
that's what the crowd is here! Slow knuckle ball way outside off, Dhoni pulls that away into the leg side while his right hand comes off the bat. Sails over deep midwicket
such a slow bouncer at 111.7kmh that Thakur pauses his pull halfway through and gets one over the keeper
from wide of the crease towards off at 131.2kmh, Dhoni chips it towards long-on for one
108.4kmh, slow and short, goes off the top edge to deep square for one
89kmh, the wrong'un around off and he defends it to leg for one. Dhoni won't take strike next over
gone this time, there goes the leg stump! Santner puts his front foot aside for the big hit but the ball hurries through him to rattle into the stumps
quick on the stumps and he's beaten by pace, 94.1kmh. Sounded like an edge on his pad
straight down long-on's throat! Flat and quick, much fuller, and Jadeja wants to go big down the ground but can't get much distance. Miller hardly moves to pouch that one
92.7kmh, quick outside off and Jadeja cuts it straight to short third
flat on the pads and worked away for one
not much pace, as expected, and Jadeja pulls to deep midwicket where Umesh does very well to keep it inside
108.2kmh, really slow length ball on off stump and Dhoni patiently pushes it down to long-off

another good catch for Noor, anther wicket for Mohit and that's the end of Dube! Slow full toss, Dube swings down the ground but doesn't get much distance and Noor dives forward from deep midwicket to hang on to it
115.2kmh, really slow and wide outside off, going away further. Very close call and it's called a wide. Replays show that was just past the tram line and the call stays
132.5kmh, some pace on the short ball now but not all that much. Dube still misses it as it goes around head height. Not given a wide and Dube doesn't like it
slow and short around off, Jadeja has no pace to work with and gets a single to square leg with a pull
133.9kmh, slightly full outside off and he lofts that over the covers for one
finally Tyagi takes the pace off. At 120.6kmh, it's pretty wide but won't go all the way. Dube went after it outside off and got towards the toe end to deep backward point
short of length and shaping in, cramps him for room and Jadeja pushes it back for a single towards Tyagi's left
144.5kmh, again pace on the pads and Jadeja goes cross to swipe-scoop that a little fine on the leg side. Mohit showed why you shouldn't bowl pace, and Tyagi's pace is proving that

in the air on the leg side and it lands just short of deep fine leg! Short on the pads, Dube swings behind square and Abhinav Manohar sprints forward for a dive, can't get under it but does well to stop it after a bounce
pace outside off, Dube swings with a horizontal bat and it doesn't matter if he hasn't middled it. He has enough to go over mid-off
that's a straight six! Dube saw the ball was going to land in the slot and he pulled his bat back for a big backlift to hammer that straight back
four to end the over too! 111.5kmh, but full and wide and Jadeja drills that away through the covers, all along the carpet in the gap
128.5kmh, some pace on this, some length to work with and Jadeja smashes that back over Mohit's head to just beat the sprinting long-on fielder
113.4kmh, lovely inswinging yorker outside off and Jadeja can only manage an inside edge onto his pad. Wants a single but there's no chance. That one also a knuckle ball
130.3kmh, he welcomes Jadeja with some pace and a short ball. Beats Jadeja's pull for a dot ball. Second for the over

a spectacular diving catch by Noor at the boundary ends Moeen's innings! It was the short ball around off, Moeen gave that pull his everything and it went very high towards the long-on boundary where Noor got under it before diving towards his left and grabbing it with both hands
nails the slow and inswinging yorker just outside off, Moeen misses that one. That was also a knuckle ball
112.2kmh, starts with a deceiving slow bouncer and it's gone over Moeen's head. Called a wide
136.6kmh, good pace and bouncer that surprises Dube a little. He pretty much withdraws from the pull
142.6kmh, touch tighter and he guides to point this time
143kmh, pace again and Moeen uses that nicely to steer it from outside off, behind square on the off side for four
swats that short of length ball on the stumps across the line, single to leg
137.3kmh, Dube will like pace on the ball and he doesn't muscle it but gets enough for the pull for two runs
pace on from Tyagi. Short on leg and Moeen makes room to scythe it fine to deep third for one
129.8kmh, again not much pace. It's slow and straight on middle stump, no room for error for the batter, and he pushes it down to long-off for his fifty
115.9kmh, takes the pace off a fair bit for the bouncer and he makes Dube wait a lifetime to not middle the defense which was also not far from the stumps
129.2kmh, not a quick bouncer that started on the stumps line, Dube wants to pull but lets it go
nearly gone first ball! Swinging in from off stump, Dube pushes at it tentatively and gets an inside edge that just misses the stumps

the knuckle ball does it from Mohit, breaks the century stand! At 114kmh right on off stump, the lack of pace deceives the batter who swings down the ground and miscues it to long-off. Mohit celebrates with his usual folded hands and eyes shut
Short ball at 130.7kmh just outside off and Mitchell goes across early to scoop that over the keeper but misses. Not as much pace as the other quicks
swings hard for the fullish delivery well outside off, gets a thick edge to leg
tad shorter and this time he heaves with the spin to deep midwicket for one
quick, flat and turning in, he pushes to cover
good reply from Rashid to bowl a flatter one right on the stumps, Mitchell adjusts and gets a single to long-on
Rashid goes fuller and Mitchell slams that back over his head, bisects long-on and long-off for four more!
charges down the track to take the ball on the full and lofts that legbreak over the covers with the turn for four
loopy delivery well outside leg and Mitchell sweeps it fine for a quick single
sweeps away but only gets an edge to deep square leg for one
quicker and flatter outside off, pushes it back this time
the sea of yellow loves the third six in a row! Short length still, turning in, and Moeen pulls that square right off the middle of the bat
that's two in two! Width this time outside off, it's quite short again and that's another six straight down, this one much straighter
short and slow, not much bounce and Moeen rocks back to muscle that over long-on for a big six. A slightly Klaasen kind of shot that
another stifled appeal as it hits him well outside leg after pitching outside leg. Another leg bye
nurdles that googly with the turn square of the wicket for one and that's Mitchell's 27-ball fifty
worked down to long-on with the turn for one more
much, much fuller on the stumps and it's lofted down to long-off for one
excellent placement for four! It was the googly turning in, short too, which gave Mitchell the time to rock back and slam it wide of long-on
appeals first ball as Moeen is hit on the pads first ball, but outside leg and it pitched outside leg too. Won't stop them from taking a leg bye
short, flat and wide too, he cuts it away to point for one more
slow, short and outside off, quite flat too and he pushes it to cover
goes on the back foot and cuts behind square for one more
swings down the ground in the air and between two fielders in the deep for two
reverse sweeps that one behind square for one
turning into the pads and Moeen clips it to leg for one

what was that?! It's a short ball that reaches Mitchell around head height, he wants to pull that away but he stops as soon as the bat makes contact with the ball so the ball flies right over the keeper's head for four while Mitchell is posing with his bat paused in front of his face
just outside off from back of a length, he steers it to point for one
digs it into the pitch at 137.6kmh, Moeen goes for the ramp but misses
towards the pads now and they get an easy leg bye off the pads behind square

straight bat, beauty with beastly power and that's beaten everyone! Quite a decent length ball on off, but Mitchell is in the zone now and he packs some power into that straight drive while getting under it to beat the bowler and the diving long-on fielder
scythed over backward point and that's the fifty stand! Short and wide, room for Mitchell to free his arms and he cuts that on the up for a one-bounce four
143.2kmh, length delivery outside off is driven straight down to long-off for one
another thick outside edge off Moeen's bat and he gets one to deep third
pulled away for six! This short ball is not that dangerous, without the extra bounce and it reaches Moeen's chest height nicely to be swatted away
140.4kmh, good short ball that angles away from Moeen and he lets it go
angling in again and he clips it through midwicket for one
just over deep backward square for six! Mitchell opened up his stance and swing that like a gold club on the leg side to just beat the leaping fielder in the deep, Jayant Yadav
147.5kmh, full on the stumps and it's drilled down to long-on for one
Mitchell sizes up for the pull to leg but that bouncer goes just over him. Second bouncer for the over
goes back and across to nudge the ball from off to long-on for one
back on the pads and he clips it to midwicket
bangs in the bouncer that goes away from Moeen. He's hoping it's a wide and it's given
pulls the short ball high into the sky, luckily for Moeen it lands just beyond the sprinting midwicket fielder and he gets two
outside off, way outside off, and Moeen goes after that one with hard hands for an edge that goes flying over the wide slip fielder for four
starts with a wide down the leg side past the pads
a bouncer at 140.5kmh to end the over, Mitchell goes for the pull and is beaten by the bounce
143.2kmh, quick and short outside off and Moeen pulls it into the ground on the leg side for one
no fine leg in the deep but this one is short on the pads and Moeen pulls that away behind square for the second four of the over
short of length and tight outside off, Mitchell punches to point and wants a single but he's sent back. But the throw from point Leakes an overthrow
outside off, he plays that on the up and gets a thick edge flying to deep third
swung across the line and Moeen is all smiles because he has picked the gap between mid-on and midwicket for a four along the ground
full again and he goes downtown again! Right on middle stump and this time Mitchell goes more classical than the previous shot with a straighter bat and gets four over mid-on
swung down the ground for the first six of the innings! Pitched up slightly and Mitchell opens up his arms to dispatch that over mid-on
the short ball after the yorker, Moeen pulls it square for one
139.7kmh, beaten again! Superb yorker just outside off, Moeen probably wasn't expecting one in the block hole and is beaten completely
chases this one and misses. Short of length and going away from him with the angle and some away swing, he's beaten
nails the yorker on middle and leg, and Mitchell bunts it down to mid-on

edged behind but it falls short of the keeper! That could have easily been the fourth, given the bounce we saw at the start of the over. Moeen chased the wide delivery outside off, got a thick edge but it pretty much died after that

has he taken it, is it a six? Rashid is smiling at the end and tha might be number three for CSK already! Pulled straight to deep square leg where Rashid first takes the catch but his right leg is about to touch the boundary cushion and Rashid throws the ball back in just in time. Clean so far, let's move forward. Just when he catches the ball again, his right foot has come off and landed again juuuust before the cushions. There's no movement of the cushion at that moment, and Rashid's smile stays
some pace off at 137.2kmh, it was short and dug in, and Mitchell pulled it down to mid-on. Couldn't middle it though
a more accurate delivery with outswing just outside eoff, Mitchell opens up completely and swings wildly down the ground for a thick edge through the slip region for four
lot of pace (146kmh), lot of width, lot of swing and lot of bounce as Wade has to pretty much fly to his right to stop that one past the swinging bat
some width outside off and Mitchell scythes it away to deep point for two
excellent ball to end the over. Swinging in sharply, unlike his first ball, and the captain defends it carefully
angling into the pads and Gaikwad clips his first ball to midwicket
much shorter just around off, Mitchell flat-bats it back but doesn't middle it. Still a single to mid-in
hard hands but not a massive swing down the ground, Mitchell finds mid-off with a drive back
starts off with a bouncer to the new batter, and it angles down leg

it's two in two for Gujarat Titans! Warrier strikes first ball, the home crowd dressed in yellow is loving it for reasons I can't comprehend. In the channel outside of with some outswing, Rahane merely chips the ball down with hesitation after the ball shapes away and Tewatia completes a really good catch running to his left

is that a run out in the first over? Nice and tight to end the over, short of length ball on off and Rahane drops it close to himself with soft hands and Ravindra hares across to pinch a single, but it's a direct hit from Miller who swoops in from point and hits the stumps with an underarm throw to catch Ravindra achingly short of the crease
no movement to Rahane as well now, length ball on middle, and he tucks it to leg
hint of inswing to Ravindra around middle and he punches it back for a single to mid-off
140.7kmh, outside off but no shape into Ravindra, he drives it nicely to cover
outswing outside off again, good pace at 144.8kmh, and Rahane runs it down to deep third
lovely outswing to start things off, and Rahane leaves it alone outside off
